0.npc_text: Need something sturdier than rags, or are you only here to stare at the stitching?

player_choices.text: Show me what you have for sale.

maren_ask_root.npc_text: Ask, then. Cloth doesn't fold itself.

player_choices.text: What makes good clothing around here?

maren_ask_clothing.npc_text: Good clothing in Driftwatch keeps rain off your back, salt out of the seams, and enough dignity on you that people don't mistake desperation for an invitation.
